properties.displayName: [AZ-03] Audit managed identities with Owner or Contributor at subscription scope
properties.description: Audits Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments where a ServicePrincipal holds the Owner or Contributor role definition at subscription scope. Mirrors azure/arg/AZ-03.kql. Known false positive: break-glass service principals onboarded with Owner at subscription scope — treat as time-bound, documented exemptions.
